title: MOSOKO_Spanish_Hola_42a8d6af
style: Educational pop with a bright, polished production style. The arrangement features a clean electric guitar playing rhythmic, palm-muted eighth-note patterns and occasional bright strums. A synth bass provides a steady, melodic low-end that follows the chord progression. The drum kit consists of a tight, punchy kick drum, a crisp snare, and shimmering hi-hats. Male vocals are clear and forward in the mix, delivered with a rhythmic, almost spoken-word cadence in the verses and a melodic, anthemic quality in the chorus. The track is in the key of G Major with a tempo of 120 BPM in 4/4 time.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[bright electric guitar strum, punchy kick drum]
¡Hola!
That's where it starts

[full band enters, driving pop beat]

De nada, no problem 'til the end

Agua, baño, basics visit

[Outro]
[rhythmic guitar continues]

[final kick drum hit]
